tweets.author: @RaulJuncoV
tweets.text:
Every AI agent in production runs on the same 6 patterns.

Real systems mix them:

1. Autonomous agent → the LLM acts in a feedback loop
2. Prompt chaining → one model output feeds the next step
3. Routing → each task gets sent to the right model or workflow
4. Parallelization
